description: Hold-out with bands: ALTER TABLE ... UPDATE u2 = u2 + 5 WHERE 1 on a Compact table of three parts and a Wide table of two. Stochastic: a Compact part read can take one more GetObject, and cleanup can batch two removed parts into one DeleteObjects call. Ran deterministic: the mutation card checks counts exactly.
